EPS (item 2) is the clearest case. My last block sent five years of EPS plus TTM for 64 bellwethers. This follow-up still lists all 15 sectors as missing EPS. That includes sectors where every company was sent in full and nothing was logged, such as Power and utilities and Electronics manufacturing. The "Reason given" it shows is my Ambuja note, a gap affecting one company. So two things seem to be wrong in the app:
	1.	The merge drops the data. It isn't saving sectors[].bellwethers[].eps, epsTtm and epsSource. My guess is it matches companies by symbol only inside a bellwethers list it already holds, or it works out what's "missing" from the original payload instead of the merged one. Earlier deep-dive blocks were dropped the same way; that's why I had to resend Electronics.
	2.	One log entry blocks the whole item. Any searchLog entry that starts with …bellwethers[…].eps marks the entire item as "not found", even when the data for every other company is in the same block.
I've attached dd10.json, the EPS block, so you can load it straight into the app and see where it's being dropped.
